descriptionChirho: A tribal division of Israel or other people group, referring to one of the hereditary socio-political units descended from a common ancestor (Arabic سِبْط, Korean 지파, Swahili kabila).
A wooden stick used as a walking aid, weapon, instrument of authority (scepter), or implement for striking, including Moses' staff and Aaron's rod (Arabic عَصَا, Korean 지팡이, Swahili fimbo).
A branch or shoot cut from a tree, used literally for a plant cutting or figuratively for a scion or offshoot (Korean 가지, Swahili tawi).
A rod or stick used in casting lots or divination, associated with arrow-like implements for sortition (Arabic سِهَام, Swahili mishale).
